T: Thawed out and ready to eat, buddy.
D: Two high school losers dig up a frozen caveman in their backyard and pass him off as an exchange student.
P: Serve the snacks when Link is thawed out in the garage.
S: the caveman frozen in a block of ice
A whole block of sharp cheddar set on crushed ice, cut into rough chunks at the table, with crackers and pickled onions.
Chicken drumsticks rubbed with smoked paprika, garlic and brown sugar, roasted at 220C for 40 minutes until sticky, eaten with your hands like a caveman.
the backyard where they dig the pool
Corn chips layered with black beans and cheddar, baked at 200C for 8 minutes, topped with salsa, guacamole and sour cream.
M: the backyard pool where they dig him up
Chicken thigh skewers marinated in teriyaki, ginger and garlic, grilled and served with rice and sesame.
a big hunk of meat for a big appetite
Pork ribs rubbed with salt, pepper and paprika, wrapped and baked at 150C for 2.5 hours, glazed with barbecue sauce under a hot grill, eaten off the bone.

s.note: the caveman frozen in a block of ice
s.how: Set a 500g block of sharp cheddar on a bed of crushed ice. Cut into rough chunks at the table with a big knife. Serve with crackers and pickled onions.
Rub 1kg chicken drumsticks with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder and 2 tbsp brown sugar. Roast at 220C for 40 minutes, brushing with barbecue sauce for the last 10, until sticky.

m.note: the backyard pool where they dig him up
m.how: Toss 1kg diced chicken thigh in 125ml teriyaki sauce with 1 tbsp grated ginger and 2 crushed garlic cloves and marinate for 30 minutes. Thread onto 12 skewers and grill for 10 to 12 minutes, turning and basting. Serve with steamed rice and sesame seeds.

w.how: Mix 500g Greek yoghurt with 3 tbsp honey and vanilla. Spread thin on a lined tray, scatter with 150g mixed berries and 40g crushed pistachios. Freeze 4 hours and break into shards.

d.how: Blend 2 bananas, 1 mango, 500ml orange juice and a cup of ice until thick. Pour into four tall cups with straws. Wheez the juice.
